subject: reasoning
question: 8 friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A is the immediate neighbour of B and C. H is the immediate neighbour of F and G. D is sitting to the immediate left of B. E is sitting to the immediate right of C. A and H are sitting opposite each other. Who is sitting immediate right of B?
solution:
**Given : **8 friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

**Explanation : **

1) A is the immediate neighbour of B and C.

2) D is sitting to the immediate left of B.

3) E is sitting to the immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed316ea4510fd78d659bbdf9784132314c11fe5f1b877a682e70616cd5b7183a.png] 

4) H is the immediate neighbour of F and G.

5) A and H are sitting opposite each other.

As position of F and G is not known with respect to H, therefore there are two possible positions for F and G.

After positioning F, G and H only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad6e4cb24192870baffdedddb8f092d3ce8cc7f836f7b1c92f5b12b8a67507ad.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement A is sitting immediate right of B.

Hence, **"A"** is the correct answer.
